name: Judas the Galilean
title: Rebel leader at the time of the census
summary: Judas from Galilee led a revolt at the time when the people were enrolled in the census. The Pharisee Gamaliel referred to him and to Theudas as examples of movements that came to nothing, when he advised the Council to leave the apostles alone.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned by Gamaliel
keyEvents.description: Gamaliel cited Judas the Galilean, whose followers were scattered, as an example when he spoke on behalf of the apostles before the Council.
